text: Mind the forge, it bites harder than I do.
Bellfounder's the last of a trade, {player}. Last of the Coils too. What do you want?
You've got soot on your boots already. Ashfall does that.
Ysolde sent you, didn't she? Thinks I can cast a bell to silence the Drowned one. She's right, curse her, if I had the shards.
Heard my bell did its work. Forty years since I cast anything that mattered. Thank you for that.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: Tell me about the Drowned Bell.

text: Pour bronze, tune it, hang it. A good bell's heard across three islands. A great one's heard by things that aren't alive.
My great-grandmother cast the bells for Saint Vesper. I've cast exactly one bell in twenty years worth hanging.
Because the volcano's warm, the clay's good, and nobody comes to bother me. Usually.
The smugglers up in the hills keep their distance. They know I've got a forge and a temper.
Storms on Ashfall are something else. The lightning finds the mountain like a moth finds a lamp.
Captain Ashmere Thorne had it cast to call his drowned crew back from the sea. It worked too well.
A bell's just a voice. Thorne's said 'come back'. Mine says 'be still'. Simple, when you put it like that. Hard, when you pour it.
